cameras.view: three gliders on the east bank
cameras.how_estimated: Camera not at the pin: put on the east-bank edge about 60 m north of glider 1, looking south down the line. Target is the centroid of the pins for sites 193, 194 and 197 (the three glider positions on the map sheet). The pin may mark the glider or the photographer; the sheet does not say. Position is a guess from the map sheet's zone 0 description.

cameras.how_estimated: Camera at the site 992 pin (on the deck line, west end). Looking east along the road deck at the east end of the bridge; the bridge runs roughly east-west across a north-south canal. Site 991 (pin 1.1, 44.7) is a second view next to 992 and is the fallback. Heading east is an assumption from the map sheet text.
cameras.status: first estimate, to be corrected by Stan against the thumbnail in S6

cameras.view: bridge from the west, glider tails beyond the canal
cameras.how_estimated: Camera at the site 989 pin, about 45 m west of the origin on the west bank by the cafe. Target is the east-bank point 40 m east and 40 m south of the origin, where the glider tails should show beyond the canal (sheet: bridge from the far side, glider tails beyond). Heading follows from that target.
